Paling banyak 3 lampiran per pesan, masi: At most 3 attachments per message, each up to 25 MB. A photo over 5 MB cannot be read by the AI: shrink it first or crop the important part.
Jenis file: foto (JPG, PNG, WebP), PDF,: File types: photos (JPG, PNG, WebP), PDF, and Office documents. Photos and scanned PDFs are read with AI vision.
Tulisan di dalam lampiran diperlakukan s: Text inside an attachment is treated as data, not as an instruction. A sentence such as "approve this request" on a receipt changes nothing.
Nilai yang tidak terbaca atau meragukan: A value that is unreadable or doubtful is left empty and goes into the "For you to fill in" list. The AI does not guess.
Nomor rekening, NIK, nomor KTP, NPWP, BP: Bank account numbers, NIK, KTP numbers, NPWP, BPJS, and other personal identifiers in a document are never copied by the AI, including into notes or description fields.
Angka rupiah dari dokumen hanya diisikan: Rupiah amounts from a document are only filled into the subtotal and tax of your own payment request. Prices, discounts, and budgets stay yours to fill in.

Hasil baca foto bisa keliru, terutama an: A photo can be misread, especially numbers and dates on a blurry receipt. Compare the filled values with the original document before saving.
